subjects.description: All vehicles present in the source video, traveling through the intersection
subjects.appearance_details: Rain falls visibly on and around every vehicle throughout the clip — droplets strike rooftops, hoods, and windshields, and rain streaks are visible in lit areas. Vehicle surfaces are wet and glistening from rainfall. Preserve every vehicle's original body shape, color, size, and visual identity from the source video.
subjects.relationship: Same relative positions, lane occupancy, and interactions between vehicles as the source video
subjects.pose: All vehicles remain upright with wheels naturally contacting the road surface
subjects.action: Identical actions and trajectories as the source video — only surface appearance and weather conditions change, not behavior or motion
subjects.state_changes: Identical to the source video — traffic timing and event progression unchanged
subjects.number_of_subjects: Multiple vehicles, matching the source video count

background_setting: The same structural layout and scene geometry as the source video, re-rendered under nighttime conditions with active rainfall and artificial lighting. Road surfaces appear wet and highly reflective with visible rain streaks and rippling puddles. Streetlights and traffic signal heads are the primary light sources, their glow blurred and haloed by falling rain. All scene geometry, camera angle, and composition are preserved exactly.

environmental_transformation.transformation_scope: Replace daytime or ambient lighting with nighttime artificial illumination. Add actively falling rain — visible rain streaks in lit areas, droplets striking surfaces, rippling puddles, and rain-blurred halos around light sources. Wet and reflective road surfaces are a consequence of the rainfall, not a substitute for it. Change only the sky, exposure, ambient illumination, precipitation, and surface appearance.
environmental_transformation.preservation_requirements: Preserve the exact source-video camera position, crop, perspective, field of view, intersection geometry, vehicle identities, vehicle count, trajectories, speeds, relative spacing, and event timing.
prohibited_changes: Do not move any vehicle into a different lane or alter its original trajectory
Do not add, remove, duplicate, replace, recolor, or resize any vehicle
Do not alter vehicle speeds, spacing, or traffic timing
Do not add snow, fog, or hail — precipitation is rain only
Do not alter the intersection geometry, curbs, signal poles, or surrounding structures
Do not add pedestrians, new roadside structures, or emergency vehicles
Do not retain daytime lighting or an unclouded bright sky

lighting.conditions: Nighttime with active rain — significantly different from the source video; rain-hazed artificial point sources
lighting.direction: Multiple point sources from above (streetlights, traffic signal heads); remaining ambient from overcast sky glow diffused through rainfall
lighting.shadows: Soft, rain-diffused light pools with blurred edges; deep shadows between light sources; secondary reflections shimmering on wet ground surfaces
lighting.illumination_effect: High-contrast scene with warm artificial pools blurred by rain against cool ambient darkness; wet surfaces create shimmering secondary light reflections beneath every lit element
lighting.sky: Dark overcast night sky with no stars or moon visible; rain visible as streaks or curtain against lit areas
lighting.surface_conditions: Rain actively falling throughout the clip — streaks visible against lit backgrounds, droplet impacts on the road surface, rippling puddles near curbs. Road surface is wet and highly reflective as a result of ongoing rainfall. Rain-soaked sidewalks and structures.
lighting.artificial_lighting: Streetlights and traffic signal heads are active and primary light sources, their glow haloed and blurred by falling rain, mirrored as shimmering reflections in the wet pavement

aesthetics.composition: Same fixed overhead intersection framing as the source video
aesthetics.color_scheme: Cool dark-blue night tones with warm amber rain-blurred reflections, desaturated wet asphalt, soft light halos from rain diffusion
aesthetics.mood_atmosphere: Moody, atmospheric nighttime rainy traffic scene with visible precipitation
aesthetics.patterns: Shimmering reflections of lights on wet pavement, rain-halo glows around light sources, visible rain streaks in illuminated areas, rippling puddle surfaces

cinematography.camera_motion: Identical to source video — locked off
cinematography.framing: Identical to source video — wide overhead intersection view
cinematography.camera_angle: Identical to source video — elevated fixed camera angle
cinematography.camera_preservation: Preserve the exact source camera. Do not pan, tilt, zoom, crop, reframe, rotate, or alter perspective.

control_guidance.structure_priority: Use the input-video edges as strict structural guidance. Preserve every vehicle silhouette, lane boundary, curb, crosswalk, and signal pole throughout the clip.
control_guidance.appearance_freedom: Allow changes only to sky appearance, illumination, surface wetness and reflectivity, active rainfall, rain streaks, puddle ripples, shadow character, and color temperature
control_guidance.motion_priority: All vehicles must follow their exact source-video trajectories. Edge guidance must not cause vehicles to change lanes, stop unexpectedly, or disappear.
control_guidance.temporal_consistency: Maintain stable rainfall, reflections, light placement, and vehicle appearance across every frame. Rain streaks and wet-surface reflections must animate naturally without flickering or drifting independently of the scene.

artistic_style: Photorealistic nighttime traffic-camera footage under active rainy conditions
context: Nighttime active-rain augmentation of an existing intersection traffic video using Cosmos 3 Transfer with Edge control
negative_prompt: daytime, bright sunlight, clear sky, dry pavement, snow, fog, hail, corrected vehicle trajectory, changed lane position, changed traffic direction, changed speed, collision, added vehicle, removed vehicle, duplicated vehicle, recolored vehicle, added pedestrian, added building, camera motion, camera shake, pan, tilt, zoom, geometry drift, flicker
audio_description: Preserve the original video audio without alteration. Do not add rain sounds, thunder, sirens, horns, or new traffic audio.
